style_guide: Use a formal legal register. Translate faithfully and completely; never add, explain, summarise or complete text. Keep the source order and structure. Keep identifiers (ID, tax, serial and reference numbers, verification codes, URLs, emails, hashes) exactly as written. Keep dates and numbers as written in the source unless the job asks to localise them. Use formal Hindi legal register. Notes: // मुहर: ... // , // हस्ताक्षर // .

labels.repeated_notes_heading: सभी पृष्ठों पर अंकित मुहरें और हस्ताक्षर
